name: Side-hustle profit calculator
audience: People testing a small cash business on weekends.
summary: Subtract materials, fees, and delivery from sales, then divide profit by hours.
description: The sample is a weekend baked-goods table. Profit is sales minus costs. The hourly figure uses the hours you type, including shopping and delivery, not only the stall time.
benefits: See profit after platform fees and materials
Turn profit into an hourly figure
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
